age_and_abandonment.conflict_age_rule: the API exposes no 'conflicted since'; the reported age is an UPPER BOUND, min(now - branch head commit time, now - last origin/main commit touching a conflicted path)

conflicted_prs.rule: abandoned iff idle_days (now - updated_at) >= 14; `updated_at` is the last activity on the PR, and is an approximation of abandonment, not a read of intent

whole_open_queue.rule: abandoned iff idle_days (now - updated_at) >= 14; `updated_at` is the last activity on the PR, and is an approximation of abandonment, not a read of intent

classifier.blind_spot: A file produced by a generator outside this repo (e.g. uv.lock by uv) that carries no banner and is named by no in-repo script is classified hand-written. The classification is evidence, not proof.
classifier.rule: generated iff (1) the first 12 lines of the file at origin/main contain a marker in (?i)(?:generated(?=[^\n]*?(?:do not edit|don't edit|not edit this|do not modify))|@generated\b|this file is generated\b|code generated\b|auto-generated\b|generated by\b), or (2) a tracked script under ['tools', 'scripts', 'graph-scripts'] WRITES this path — resolved from the AST around write calls, following simple name bindings and arguments threaded into helper functions that write their parameter, so a path merely mentioned by a writing script is NOT generated; otherwise hand-written; unreadable -> unknown

pagination.reconcile_command: gh api --paginate --slurp "repos/daniel-ospina/tortoise/pulls?state=open&per_page=100&sort=created&direction=asc" | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(sum(len(p) for p in json.load(sys.stdin)))'
